inject.title: Unhurried: A Free WordPress Theme for Businesses That Sell Care
inject.core_topic: We released Unhurried, a free, calm, editorial WordPress block theme for studios, spas and makers, plus Unhurried Pro for WooCommerce shops.
x:
Most WordPress themes are built to sell speed. Countdown timers, sticky banners, five buttons above the fold.

We made one for businesses whose whole promise is the opposite. It is free. It is called Unhurried.
27 patterns, full Homepage/About/Services/Contact pages, a blog, two extra color schemes. Everything edits in the Site Editor. No page builder.

Selling products? Unhurried Pro adds a calm WooCommerce shop, a quiet checkout and a Coming soon page. $49, one payment.

Free download and install steps: https://switchcasestudio.com/blog/unhurried-free-wordpress-theme
